```python
def reference_runs(routes):
    # routes: dict {(start,length): hop}
    entries = [(s, l, h) for (s,l),h in routes.items()]
    bounds = {0}
    for s,l,h in entries:
        bounds.add(s)
        if l > 0:
            end = s + (1 << (128-l))
            if end < (1<<128): bounds.add(end)
    bounds = sorted(bounds)
    out = []
    for b in bounds:
        best = None; bestlen = -1
        for s,l,h in entries:
            if s <= b < s + (1 << (128-l)) and l > bestlen:
                bestlen = l; best = h
        hop = best if bestlen >= 0 else None
        if out and out[-1][1] == hop: continue
        out.append((b, hop))
    if not out: out = [(0, None)]
    return [x[0] for x in out], [x[1] for x in out]
```
